questions.question:
'A + B' means 'A is the father of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A × B' means 'A is the brother of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'

If 'P - R × Q + S', then which of the following statements is true?

options.text: P is the sister-in-law of R.
P is the sister-in-law of Q.
Q is the sister-in-law of P.
P is the sister-in-law of S.

questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c67a3453c091236111e195df50f5a064151c8b472d213cd0077e68f321b6f4da.png] 

As per the given data:

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Means

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 

 
 
of B

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

**Given expression:** 'P - R × Q + S'

P is the wife of R, R is the brother of Q and Q is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ccc9bacf9ea6b58f9232fd277b3fd1990005917a3fc530d2c5d38dda04bccfa.png] 

Checking all the given options:

(1) P is the sister-in-law of R. → Incorrect

(2) P is the sister-in-law of Q. → **Correct**

(3) Q is the sister-in-law of P. → Incorrect

(4) P is the sister-in-law of S. → Incorrect

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cup : Crockery → Cup is a crockery item.

Similarly,

Sharpener : **Stationery** → Sharpener is a stationary item.

Here,'**Sharpener : ****Stationery'** is the correct pair.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pillows are bed.

Some beds are cupboards.

All cupboards are wood.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some beds are pillows.

II. Some cupboards are beds.

III. All wood are cupboards.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

All pillows are bed.

Some beds are cupboards.

All cupboards are wood.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/635737c6de0fbb0efec8673023684c7a91a38c11de682a326ddb8710f6b86a5c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some beds are pillows. → **Follow** (All pillows are bed, which means some beds are pillows is definitely true)

II. Some cupboards are beds. → **Follow** (Some beds are cupboards, which means some cupboards are beds also)

III. All wood are cupboards. → **not follow** (All cupboards are wood, which means some wood are cupboards, all wood are cupboards is a possibility only but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Both conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

24 × 16 + 8 - 36 ÷ 18 = 30
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 24 × 16 + 8 - 36 ÷ 18 = 30

(1) - and +

⇒ 24 × 16 + 8 - 36 ÷ 18 = 30

After changing the signs:

⇒ 24 × 16 - 8 + __**36 ÷ 18**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**24 × 16**__ - 8 + 2

⇒ 384 - 8 + 2

⇒ 386 - 8 = 378

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

questions.question:
Kirti, Suman, Shubh, Kanak, Pari, Charu, Shlok and Shivi are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Kirti sits third to the left of Shubh. Kirti sits at one of the corners. Kanak sits second to the right of Pari. Pari does not sit at any of the corners. Pari is not an immediate neighbour of Kirti. Suman is an immediate neighbour of Charu. Suman does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. Only three people sit between Suman and Shlok.

Who is an immediate neighbour of Kanak?
questions.solution: The sitting arrangement as per the given information: 1. Kirti sits at one of the corners and Kirti sits third to the left of Shubh. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61347ca46a8ed1fe7e817a80468cf3705b37e07ed09523fc7625e13850643e00.png] 2. Pari does not sit at any of the corners, Pari is not an immediate neighbour of Kirti and Kanak sits second to the right of Pari.

questions.question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Prem is an immediate neighbour of Nolan and Suraj. Madhu is sitting third to the right of Prem. Here,** 'Nolan'** is the immediate neighbour of Raj and Prem.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question:
Which option represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in the English dictionary?

1 vehicle

2 verify

3 vegan

4 venom 

5 vein
questions.solution:
The correct order of words as they would appear in the English dictionary is:

3. vegan

1. vehicle

5. vein

4. venom

2. verify

The correct order is** '3, 1, 5, 4, 2'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
